name: Advanced Terrarium Voxel Mod
description: A full 3D diorama overworld for Gen 1-3 (extruded terrain, depth-buffered occlusion, tilt-shift) and a Terrarium effects layer on Platinum's native NSBMD world -- 3D grass, wind, weather, and Colosseum/Stadium battles staged on the engine camera rather than a voxel mesh. Includes integrated Colosseum Overhaul functionality.

required_imports.name: Pokemon Colosseum (USA) Disc
required_imports.description: Pokemon Colosseum USA GC6E01 source for Colosseum Overhaul integration. This enables Colosseum battle environments, UI, Pokemon models, and audio. The launcher validates required imports before this mod runs.
